meta.title: Troublemakers
meta.description: They make their escape with a cunning scheme, plunging straight into the heart of the streets.

units.rawText: A shopping street on the event grounds, still under construction.
units.displayText: A shopping street on the event grounds, still under construction.

spans.text: A shopping street on the event grounds, still under construction.

units.rawText: Huff... huff... whew... we shook off those statues, right?
units.displayText: Huff... huff... whew... we shook off those statues, right?

spans.text: Huff... huff... whew... we shook off those statues, right?

units.rawText: If you're not feeling so certain about it, I've got another shot right here that'll help us get a bit further.
units.displayText: If you're not feeling so certain about it, I've got another shot right here that'll help us get a bit further.

spans.text: If you're not feeling so certain about it, I've got another shot right here that'll help us get a bit further.

units.rawText: Eep! No, no, I think I'd much rather be caught than get another jab from you!
units.displayText: Eep! No, no, I think I'd much rather be caught than get another jab from you!

spans.text: Eep! No, no, I think I'd much rather be caught than get another jab from you!

units.rawText: We're safe here, really. You can trust me on this one.
units.displayText: We're safe here, really. You can trust me on this one.

spans.text: We're safe here, really. You can trust me on this one.

units.rawText: Kuro takes some time to recover as she props herself up by her knees, indignantly kicking a stone by the roadside.
units.displayText: Kuro takes some time to recover as she props herself up by her knees, indignantly kicking a stone by the roadside.

spans.text: Kuro takes some time to recover as she props herself up by her knees, indignantly kicking a stone by the roadside.

units.rawText: What the hell was all of that? Something about the "grounds entering lockdown mode", and then all the statues came for us.
units.displayText: What the hell was all of that? Something about the "grounds entering lockdown mode", and then all the statues came for us.

spans.text: What the hell was all of that? Something about the "grounds entering lockdown mode", and then all the statues came for us.

units.rawText: The security's all kinds of messed up! It's just in such awful taste to use those statues of Puzzle's as guards!
units.displayText: The security's all kinds of messed up! It's just in such awful taste to use those statues of Puzzle's as guards!

spans.text: The security's all kinds of messed up! It's just in such awful taste to use those statues of Puzzle's as guards!

units.rawText: Well, Horizon's already been placed in position. I've no doubt she'll give our friends a surprise~
units.displayText: Well, Horizon's already been placed in position. I've no doubt she'll give our friends a surprise~

spans.text: Well, Horizon's already been placed in position. I've no doubt she'll give our friends a surprise~

units.rawText: A shame I didn't get that on camera. It would've made for such good content!
units.displayText: A shame I didn't get that on camera. It would've made for such good content!

spans.text: A shame I didn't get that on camera. It would've made for such good content!

units.rawText: Kuro's mouth skews a little as she produces her camera. At the sight of the countless vividly laden stalls, however, she perks right up immediately.
units.displayText: Kuro's mouth skews a little as she produces her camera. At the sight of the countless vividly laden stalls, however, she perks right up immediately.

spans.text: Kuro's mouth skews a little as she produces her camera. At the sight of the countless vividly laden stalls, however, she perks right up immediately.

units.rawText: But seeing as we're in the commercial district, content won't be a problem. The big stuff comes later, anyway!
units.displayText: But seeing as we're in the commercial district, content won't be a problem. The big stuff comes later, anyway!

spans.text: But seeing as we're in the commercial district, content won't be a problem. The big stuff comes later, anyway!

units.rawText: What are your plans next, Florence? We've already accomplished our goal of sneaking in together. Are we going to continue moving together?
units.displayText: What are your plans next, Florence? We've already accomplished our goal of sneaking in together. Are we going to continue moving together?

spans.text: What are your plans next, Florence? We've already accomplished our goal of sneaking in together. Are we going to continue moving together?

units.rawText: I plan to go inspect the stall that we requested and find out just who nicked the spot from me.
units.displayText: I plan to go inspect the stall that we requested and find out just who nicked the spot from me.

spans.text: I plan to go inspect the stall that we requested and find out just who nicked the spot from me.

units.rawText: The Medical Department is more than happy to provide treatment to able-bodied citizens of the Oasis.
units.displayText: The Medical Department is more than happy to provide treatment to able-bodied citizens of the Oasis.

spans.text: The Medical Department is more than happy to provide treatment to able-bodied citizens of the Oasis.

units.rawText: I will spare a second of prayer for that nameless agent, then.
units.displayText: I will spare a second of prayer for that nameless agent, then.

spans.text: I will spare a second of prayer for that nameless agent, then.

units.rawText: Just a second?
units.displayText: Just a second?

spans.text: Just a second?

units.rawText: That's all the compassion this poor little Kuro can spare! Right, do you mind helping me out with something, seeing as we've gone this far together?
units.displayText: That's all the compassion this poor little Kuro can spare! Right, do you mind helping me out with something, seeing as we've gone this far together?

spans.text: That's all the compassion this poor little Kuro can spare! Right, do you mind helping me out with something, seeing as we've gone this far together?

units.rawText: Hm? If it contributes towards the betterment of the event and the unity of the Oasis, why, I'd be more than happy!
units.displayText: Hm? If it contributes towards the betterment of the event and the unity of the Oasis, why, I'd be more than happy!

spans.text: Hm? If it contributes towards the betterment of the event and the unity of the Oasis, why, I'd be more than happy!

units.rawText: Hehe! I knew you'd understand me.
units.displayText: Hehe! I knew you'd understand me.

spans.text: Hehe! I knew you'd understand me.

units.rawText: I want you to record the details about every stall that you walk by, especially places that look important.
units.displayText: I want you to record the details about every stall that you walk by, especially places that look important.

spans.text: I want you to record the details about every stall that you walk by, especially places that look important.

units.rawText: They want to keep their secrets, hmm? Then we'll take all the secrets they have!
units.displayText: They want to keep their secrets, hmm? Then we'll take all the secrets they have!

spans.text: They want to keep their secrets, hmm? Then we'll take all the secrets they have!

units.rawText: Alright, seeing as Kuro's making this request of me.
units.displayText: Alright, seeing as Kuro's making this request of me.

spans.text: Alright, seeing as Kuro's making this request of me.

units.rawText: I've a mind to see just what they've done, too. Seeing as the request we worked so diligently on was rejected, I'd hardly be able to accept just any schmuck coming along and taking our spot.
units.displayText: I've a mind to see just what they've done, too. Seeing as the request we worked so diligently on was rejected, I'd hardly be able to accept just any schmuck coming along and taking our spot.

spans.text: I've a mind to see just what they've done, too. Seeing as the request we worked so diligently on was rejected, I'd hardly be able to accept just any schmuck coming along and taking our spot.

units.rawText: Ok, I'll leave that direction to you then.
units.displayText: Ok, I'll leave that direction to you then.

spans.text: Ok, I'll leave that direction to you then.

units.rawText: This is the photography equipment. If there really is something juicy, do your best to keep your hands steady.
units.displayText: This is the photography equipment. If there really is something juicy, do your best to keep your hands steady.

spans.text: This is the photography equipment. If there really is something juicy, do your best to keep your hands steady.

units.rawText: You can leave it to me. Rather, Kuro, will you be alright?
units.displayText: You can leave it to me. Rather, Kuro, will you be alright?

spans.text: You can leave it to me. Rather, Kuro, will you be alright?

units.rawText: You're in pitiful physical shape. Without my remedies, could you hope to shake off a pursuer?
units.displayText: You're in pitiful physical shape. Without my remedies, could you hope to shake off a pursuer?

spans.text: You're in pitiful physical shape. Without my remedies, could you hope to shake off a pursuer?

units.rawText: Tch, that... is a problem.
units.displayText: Tch, that... is a problem.

spans.text: Tch, that... is a problem.

units.rawText: Kuro furrows her brow in thought, catching a glimpse of her half-open backpack in the corner of her vision.
units.displayText: Kuro furrows her brow in thought, catching a glimpse of her half-open backpack in the corner of her vision.

spans.text: Kuro furrows her brow in thought, catching a glimpse of her half-open backpack in the corner of her vision.

units.rawText: I've got it! We can use this! This is a drone we use for stream ambience, specially made to create a ruckus.
units.displayText: I've got it! We can use this! This is a drone we use for stream ambience, specially made to create a ruckus.

spans.text: I've got it! We can use this! This is a drone we use for stream ambience, specially made to create a ruckus.

units.rawText: I'll write up a few extra lines of programming so it'll circle around all of those other places. It'll divert all of the attention away from us.
units.displayText: I'll write up a few extra lines of programming so it'll circle around all of those other places. It'll divert all of the attention away from us.

spans.text: I'll write up a few extra lines of programming so it'll circle around all of those other places. It'll divert all of the attention away from us.

units.rawText: Most impressive, my dear Kuro~ Allow me to make things a little more entertaining.
units.displayText: Most impressive, my dear Kuro~ Allow me to make things a little more entertaining.

spans.text: Most impressive, my dear Kuro~ Allow me to make things a little more entertaining.

units.rawText: A lively environment must have some color to it, you know!
units.displayText: A lively environment must have some color to it, you know!

spans.text: A lively environment must have some color to it, you know!

units.rawText: Florence wedges a vial of a powdery substance into the drone's inner hold with her eyes aglow, giggling to herself all the while.
units.displayText: Florence wedges a vial of a powdery substance into the drone's inner hold with her eyes aglow, giggling to herself all the while.

spans.text: Florence wedges a vial of a powdery substance into the drone's inner hold with her eyes aglow, giggling to herself all the while.

units.rawText: Tsk tsk, this stuff isn't dangerous, is it?
units.displayText: Tsk tsk, this stuff isn't dangerous, is it?

spans.text: Tsk tsk, this stuff isn't dangerous, is it?

units.rawText: Oh, relax; all of it was made in advance for the festival. To get it past examination, I really did do my very best to make them harmless.
units.displayText: Oh, relax; all of it was made in advance for the festival. To get it past examination, I really did do my very best to make them harmless.

spans.text: Oh, relax; all of it was made in advance for the festival. To get it past examination, I really did do my very best to make them harmless.

units.rawText: A pity that the Professor and those on the event committee fail to appreciate the finer beauties of a concoction. I'll have to introduce it to them by force~
units.displayText: A pity that the Professor and those on the event committee fail to appreciate the finer beauties of a concoction. I'll have to introduce it to them by force~

spans.text: A pity that the Professor and those on the event committee fail to appreciate the finer beauties of a concoction. I'll have to introduce it to them by force~

units.rawText: Hehe, I'm looking forward to the look on their faces.
units.displayText: Hehe, I'm looking forward to the look on their faces.

spans.text: Hehe, I'm looking forward to the look on their faces.
